name: GLG
description: GLG gives you instant access to the world's largest expert network directly in Claude. Search thousands of expert transcripts, explore insights across industries, and review content from your own research calls — all without leaving your workflow. Every response is grounded in named, verified experts from moderated GLG-hosted conversations, giving you the primary intelligence you need to make faster, more confident decisions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GLG to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GLG to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.glgresearch.com/myglg/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GLG MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GLG lists 13 MCP tools, including Download Call Transcript, Download Library Transcript, RSVP to Event, Expert Profile, Search Experts, Get Call Transcript, Library Event Details, Library Transcript, My Calls, Search Library, My Projects, and Search My Calls.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GLG?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GLG in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
GLG requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
GLG is developed by Gerson Lehrman Group. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
